caption: The drawing depicts a single, metallic object resembling a tool or weapon positioned vertically and centered against a plain, light beige background. The object itself is rendered in shades of gray and brown to illustrate its metallic texture, with intricate detailing showing shadows and highlights. It features a long, straight handle or shaft at the top ending with two prominent, circular loops. The main body of the object is flat and elongated with a broad, rectangular blade-like section extending downward. The blade section is decorated with a subtle diamond-patterned texture and has a serrated, saw-like edge on one side. The object also includes several decorative spiral and hook-shaped elements protruding from or attached to its main body—one near the top, one at the middle, and one extending at an angle from the bottom to the side. There is a small inscription in the lower right-hand corner of the page that reads "fig 215 page 92."
title: Trammel
